title: Match the mirrored offers
brief: Learners pin paper slips to our library corkboard hoping a matching speaker walks by the same week.

target_population.role: coordinator of a city library's tandem language-exchange board
target_population.coverage_limit: one library branch's open offers; first names only, matches meet at the desk

core_task.summary: post an exchange offer and see its reciprocal partner surface
core_task.success_oracle: posting an offer of Italian seeking Japanese immediately surfaces the seeded card offering Japanese seeking Italian as a proposed match

not_applicable_states.loading: offers are seeded local records and reciprocal matching is an in-memory scan, so posting resolves its match in the same frame

state_recipes.empty: post an offer seeking Icelandic, which no seeded card offers; the board shows a no-match-yet panel that keeps the offer pinned
state_recipes.validation-error: choose the same language in both the offering and seeking fields; an inline error refuses the post
state_recipes.success: post Italian-for-Japanese as Carla; Yuki's reciprocal card rises under the match banner
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the offering-language picker shows its focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the board at 390x844; offer cards flow single-column beneath the post form

acceptance_facts: The seed board carries six open offers spanning five languages with poster first names only.
Posting Italian-for-Japanese surfaces Yuki's reciprocal card as a proposed match at once.
Offering and seeking the same language is refused with an inline error before posting.

product_signature.mechanism: reciprocal-pair matcher that lights up when two offers mirror each other
product_signature.brief_trace: hoping a matching speaker walks by the same week
product_signature.counterfactual: a classifieds list would fit a noticeboard brief and never detects that two slips mirror each other
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows Carla's new offer beside Yuki's card under the match banner

anti_goals: no chat, messaging, or contact exchange; matched pairs meet via the library desk
no accounts or profiles beyond a first name
no proficiency levels, tests, or scoring

content_seed.data_notes: six invented offers; Yuki's card is the planted reciprocal for the core task and no card offers Icelandic, fixing the empty state
